title: 掩埋場最終覆蓋
summary: 本課以「將防滲、排水、沉陷與植生整合為掩埋場最終覆蓋證據」為主軸，依序處理覆蓋層功能分工、低滲透層完整性、差異沉陷與裂縫、植生含水與季節、巡查空間覆蓋。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
summaryEn: This course focuses on Integrate infiltration control, drainage, settlement and vegetation into landfill-cover evidence, progressing through Roles of cover layers, Integrity of the low-permeability layer, Differential settlement and cracking, Vegetation moisture and seasonality, Inspection spatial coverage. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.
scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 覆蓋層功能分工：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Roles of cover layers: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 覆蓋層功能分工 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Roles of cover layers and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 將植生層、排水層與低滲透層分開，材料體積與壓實狀態要依各層記帳。 材料體積依堆積密度而變；粒子密度不可直接代替含孔隙的堆積密度。
steps.instructionEn: Separate vegetation, drainage and low-permeability layers, accounting for volume and compaction by layer. Material volume depends on bulk density; particle density cannot replace density including pores.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：固體質量 m=6000 kg；假設堆積密度 rho=1500 kg/m³。公式 V=m/rho，計算得 4 m³。適用邊界：已知乾濕基與均勻堆積，未包含後續壓密與膨脹。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Solid mass m=6000 kg; assumed bulk density rho=1500 kg/m³. Formula V=m/rho gives 4 m³. Applicability: Known moisture basis and uniform packing; later consolidation and swelling are omitted.
steps.failure: 把粒子密度當堆積密度會低估運輸或覆層需要體積。 在「覆蓋層功能分工」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Using particle density as bulk density underestimates hauling or cover volume. Mark where this error can enter the Roles of cover layers flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「覆蓋層功能分工」，用已知容積箱和秤重核對密度，將鬆填、壓實與乾濕狀態分欄。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Roles of cover layers, Check density using a known-volume container and scale, separating loose, compacted, wet and dry conditions. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只將 rho 改成 1200 kg/m³，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 4 變成 5 m³。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
knowledge.textEn: Change only bulk density rho to 1200 kg/m³, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 4 to 5 m³. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

steps.title: 降雨、蒸散與滲漏：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Rainfall, evapotranspiration and leakage: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 降雨、蒸散與滲漏 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Rainfall, evapotranspiration and leakage and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 蒸散型與低滲透型覆蓋的主導機制不同，水量比較需保留儲水項。 水量平衡以降雨扣除蒸散、逕流及儲量變化估剩餘向下通量。
steps.instructionEn: Evapotranspirative and low-permeability covers rely on different mechanisms; retain storage in water comparisons. A water balance estimates residual downward flux after evapotranspiration, runoff and storage change.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：面積 A=10000 m²；期間雨量 P=0.08 m；蒸散 ET=0.025 m；逕流 R=0.03 m；儲量增加 ΔS=0.005 m。公式 V=A*(P-ET-R-dS)，計算得 200 m³。適用邊界：同一時間窗與面積；每項均為教學輸入，不含橫向地下水。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Area A=10000 m²; rainfall P=0.08 m; evapotranspiration ET=0.025 m; runoff R=0.03 m; storage increase ΔS=0.005 m. Formula V=A*(P-ET-R-dS) gives 200 m³. Applicability: One time window and area; all terms are teaching inputs and lateral groundwater is excluded.
steps.failure: 忽略儲水變化會把短期蓄水誤認為永久減滲。 在「降雨、蒸散與滲漏」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Ignoring storage change mistakes short-term retention for permanent seepage reduction. Mark where this error can enter the Rainfall, evapotranspiration and leakage flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「降雨、蒸散與滲漏」，將雨量、量測排水與含水變化對齊，對未知項給區間而非強制零殘差。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
